message.content: Both open claims are independent numeric-accuracy claims. I'll launch two probes together: c1 with a dense sweep of all 61440 finite FP16 values (including subnormals, zeros, and extrema), and c2 focused on the extrema ±65504.

function.arguments:
{"claim_id": "c1", "code": "import torch, numpy as np, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_135")
import kernel

# all finite FP16 values
bits = np.arange(65536, dtype=np.uint16)
vals = bits.view(np.float16)
finite = np.isfinite(vals)
x = torch.from_numpy(vals[finite].copy()).to("cuda")
print("num_finite", x.numel(), file=sys.stderr)

out = kernel.run(x)
ref = x.to(torch.float64) / torch.sqrt(1.0 + x.to(torch.float64) * x.to(torch.float64))
err = (out.to(torch.float64) - ref).abs()
maxi = int(err.argmax())
print(json.dumps({
    "num_inputs": int(x.numel()),
    "max_abs_err": float(err.max()),
    "tolerance": 1e-6,
    "argmax_x": float(x[maxi].item()),
    "worst_x_abs": float(abs(x[maxi].item())),
    "num_violations": int((err > 1e-6).sum()),
    "out_at_worst": float(out[maxi].item()),
    "ref_at_worst": float(ref[maxi].item())
}))
", "expected_signal": "max absolute error over all finite FP16 values vs FP64 reference, compared to 1e-6", "timeout_s": 300}

function.arguments:
{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import torch, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_135")
import kernel

x = torch.tensor([65504.0, -65504.0, 60000.0, -60000.0], dtype=torch.float16, device="cuda")
out = kernel.run(x)
xd = x.to(torch.float64)
ref = xd / torch.sqrt(1.0 + xd * xd)
err = (out.to(torch.float64) - ref).abs()
# also examine a range of large values
xs = torch.linspace(30000, 65504, 2001, dtype=torch.float32).to(torch.float16).to("cuda")
out2 = kernel.run(xs)
xd2 = xs.to(torch.float64)
ref2 = xd2 / torch.sqrt(1.0 + xd2 * xd2)
err2 = (out2.to(torch.float64) - ref2).abs()
print(json.dumps({
    "extrema_errs": [float(e) for e in err],
    "extrema_inputs": [float(v) for v in x],
    "large_range_max_abs_err": float(err2.max()),
    "large_range_violations_gt_1e-6": int((err2 > 1e-6).sum()),
    "large_range_worst_x": float(xs[int(err2.argmax())].item()),
    "tolerance": 1e-6
}))
", "expected_signal": "absolute error at x=±65504 and large |x| range vs 1e-6 tolerance", "timeout_s": 300}
